page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top; page number 391 at top right. Main text in one column of roman type with headings COSTERVS (centred), TERTIA, and SOLVTIO. Marginal notes: "Gal. 1." in the right margin beside the opening lines, and a small mark in the right margin beside "Matthaei 11." and at the level of "Solutio". Signature "Bb 4" at the foot.

main_text.p: crarum literarum trutinam examinati oportere: certa & constans interpretationis verae norma dici non poteft. Nec alio pertinet sententia Pauli; Sed etiamsi Gal. 1. nos, aut angelus, e caelo euangelizet vobis, praeter id quod vobis euangelizauimus, anathema esto. Quare quum secunda etiam ratio noftra inuicta perstet, ad tertiam procedamus.
main_text.head: COSTERVS.
TERTIA.
main_text.p: MATTHAEI: 11. Christus patri caelesti confitens, quia abscondisset haec a sapientibus & prudentibus, & reuelasset ea paruulis, significare voluit, non minus inesse gratiae imperitae multitudini, quàm inflatis doctoribus: non sunt igitur rudes abinterpretatione & iudicio Scripturarum arcendi.
main_text.head: SOLVTIO,
main_text.p: NEGANDA est consequutio; quia paruulorum nomine non quiuis imperiti, sed humiles ac nullius rei cognitione tumentes, intelligendi veniunt:

page.notes: The marginal note beside "Sed etiamsi" reads "Gal. 1." (printed as Gal. with a reference mark). Small marginal marks at the right near "reuelasset" and "Solutio" are unreadable and omitted. Catchword/page furniture: running head at top, page number 391 printed as "391" with a stylised 3 at top right. Word "Matthaei" printed as "MATTHÆI" with capital initial M. Text near the top left "Christus" heading area and faint show-through from the reverse page were excluded.
